  Scene - 0.6+ only! probably in some next time...
  Well

    Ome??? for metadata, as an array of items, according to the OME metadata model

================================

- OmeZarrVersion
- StudyName
- SrcUrl             [ <- input to the benchmark ]
- License

Input parameter for: [ <- input to the benchmark ]
- pure multiscale (Images) at "subpath" (in the case that bf2r specs is used for a "series" of images)
- Labels -> subpath again
- HCS - plates
- Scene (0.6+)
- Bf2Raw ?? special kind of test, as only this one doesn't lead to 'multiscales'
==> This leads to four (4) different testbed datasets [five datasets? if Bf2Raw] <==

Obtains basic pixel/display oriented (image) parameters, with their semantics!!:
- PixelType
- AxesNames (semicolon-separated names of axes in storage order!!; to check if, at least, this has been picked up well)
- SizeX (geometry at base res level, reader must understand which one is the x-axis!)
- SizeY
- SizeZ
- SizeC - or any other mean to iterate over xyzt images/arrays/tensors
- SizeT
- ScaleX (possible anisotropy fix at base res level)
- ScaleY
- ScaleZ
- NumberOfResLevels
- ChunkCoord (input!, index of a chunk on which the hash was computed)
- ChunkHash  (output)

================================

Images:
- PathToImageMultiscales (or Path, ImagePath, ImageGroupPath, ZarrInnerPath ??)

Labels:
- PathToImageMultiscales (or Path, ImagePath, ImageGroupPath, ZarrInnerPath ??)
- LabelName           (intentionally not a path, to make reader understand and _find_, and report for benchmark verification)

HCS:
- NumberOfColumns    [ -> this is tested as well, not an input ]
- NumberOfRows       [ -> this is tested as well, not an input ]
- ColumnIndex
- RowIndex
- WellImageIndex - well has Images, an ordered list, this is an index to it
